purpose: Oncometer is a PET/CT oncology workflow extension with four modules: lesion segmentation (LION/lionz), organ segmentation (MOOSE/moosez or custom nnU-Net), lesion radiomics, and organ-level SUV quantification. It is for clinical researchers using 3D Slicer.
summary: The code has no sign of malicious behaviour, hidden telemetry or obfuscation. The main problem is environment handling. The segmentation modules call slicer.util.pip_install("lionz") and pip_install("moosez") with no confirmation. These packages bring in torch, nnunetv2 and numerous pinned dependencies from PyPI, which bypasses the PyTorchUtils and NNUNet extensions, and neither is declared in build_dependencies or EXTENSION_DEPENDS. The Radiomics module also installs scipy and scikit-image silently. The packages that moosez and lionz download at runtime (model weights) are undocumented. Minor items: scm_revision is "main", there are no real tests, and clinical disclaimers are missing. The license (MIT) is fine. Recommendation: 🔴 Do not merge yet, until the install logic is fixed.
